items.decision_note: Message 36 adds freelancer-originated Supabase schema and aggregation details beyond the client instruction in message 34; verify whether the later summary and client acceptance explicitly authorize those details.

unresolved_candidate.description: A complete production selfie-styling feature is conditional on the backend evaluation results. Current evidence clearly establishes the evaluation deliverable but does not yet authorize full production implementation.
The affiliate and campaign attribution requirement calls for two or three additional tools, but the specific providers and whether they require separate Requirement atoms remain unspecified.

Detailed Shopline widget behavior is expected in a separate one-pager. Current evidence supports one widget Requirement but is insufficient to split OAuth, content publishing, product APIs, and compliance webhooks into independent product behaviors.

The freelancer states that Stripe can be deferred, but no supplied client message clearly accepts that lifecycle change. Event extraction should not treat message 83 alone as an authoritative deferral.
